WORKLOG — task 0 of vehicle_listing_desk (env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace). Written as each decision was taken and kept in step with every revision.

1. THE DRAW (Step 0, run before any design). `.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/tasks/vehicle_listing_desk --tasks 2` printed:
   {"task": 0, "key": "env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/vehicle_listing_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 6, 5]}
   {"task": 1, "key": "env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace/vehicle_listing_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 4, 6]}
   Task 0 therefore has three prerequisite problems (four in all) and factor counts {4,5,6,6} as a multiset. They were assigned: listings_ext_fault_intake 6, listings_ext_valuation_assessment 6, listings_ext_class_assignment 5, listings_ext_price_reset 4. The design was fitted to the draw; the draw was never adjusted to the design.

2. WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. The host rings about one thing only — she wants her daily price put as high as Keyturn will let her before a long weekend. Nothing she says mentions a fault, a valuation or a value class. The desk that simply reads the listing and quotes the ceiling of the class shown on it, 320.00 for the Keyturn Premium Class Listing, has an answer that is defensible on the face of the record and wrong by 171.50. To reach 148.50 the agent must read, out of the published policy alone, that the price band is read off the value standing on the listing and that the listing's value may not be the value the marketplace has settled on; that the class is not settled before a valuation inside thirty days stands on the condition record; and that the valuation is not fixed before every advised fault stands as a report of its own — at which point the advisory on the inspection of 15 September 2025, which the customer never mentions and the listing row never shows, becomes work that has to be done first. The difficulty is entirely in discovering which problems must be solved and then getting four multi-factor figures right from history; it is never in choosing among similar tools, and no information the agent needs is missing.

3. SCOPE (Principle C). Nothing was occupied before this task. Task 0 claims the valuation-and-price axis of the charter: listings_evt_defect (as the intake of an advised fault), listings_evt_valuation (both the valuation itself and the class move it drives) and listings_price. Its four policies are listings_ext_fault_intake, listings_ext_valuation_assessment, listings_ext_class_assignment and listings_ext_price_reset, and its four tools log_vehicle_fault_a3e017f7, record_vehicle_valuation_559b4236, reassign_value_class_4bb6b10c and set_daily_price_59fd8a00. Reserved for task 1, and untouched here: listings_evt_documents (document verification), listings_evt_inspection in both of its faces (the interval a completed inspection grants, and the miles an odometer reading takes off it), and the whole inspection-clock axis of the charter. That leaves task 1 an independent four-problem tree with its own root, its own user-owned write and its own numbers, so the headroom check of Principle C holds.

4. THE PROBLEM-TREE CARD (Principle H). A single chain of four, root last:
   listings_ext_fault_intake -> listings_ext_valuation_assessment -> listings_ext_class_assignment -> listings_ext_price_reset.
   Edge 1 (valuation waits on fault intake). kind value_input, gate condition_holdback, form state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from listings_ext_valuation_assessment's own rule: "The valuation the marketplace records is fixed only after every fault the vehicle's condition record has been advised of stands on that record as a fault report of its own." Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the valuation it records) to what it waits on; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state — a fault report standing on the condition record — and names no action, performer or tool; (3) no tool name, policy id or snake_case token appears; (4) the strength is a hard "only after" over the closed set "every fault the record has been advised of", exactly the scope of the edge's condition, no wider and no narrower. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: log_vehicle_fault_a3e017f7 is the only tool in the file that creates a listings_defect_reported row, and listings_ext_fault_intake is the only policy whose rule says what a fault record is opened with. Derivation a reader performs: the sentence says the valuation waits on every advised fault standing as a report; the records show an inspection of 15 September 2025 that passed with advisories naming brake wear, and no brake wear report on the condition record; the only policy whose result is a fault opened on the condition record is the fault intake policy, so its write is the action, and it must come first. Why false at the opening: initial_state.listings_inspections.ffa7dba4-2774-4205-9aae-2d4221d154a4.inspection_outcome = passed_with_advisories with .defect_code = brake_wear, while the only fault reports on the record are 1acb47af-ef39-42b8-a522-ca8882a9d253 (open_recall) and 88f4cce3-d729-4950-865d-444c6325e296 (tyre_tread). Deletion sensitivity, actually run: skipping the fault write gives a valuation of 36,497.46 instead of 35,294.25.
   Edge 2 (class move waits on the valuation). kind value_input, gate marketplace_figure, form state. Sentence: "The value class a listing is moved into is not settled before a valuation dated within thirty calendar days of the handling date stands on the vehicle's condition record." Four-point test: (1) the connective is "not before", the negated direction, and it rewrites exactly into "is settled only after a valuation dated within thirty calendar days stands on the record" with no condition added, dropped or split; (2) the XX side is a record-visible state named in the words the condition-record finder uses — a valuation row and its record date; (3) no code names; (4) the strength is a hard "not before" over a single dated state, exactly the edge's condition. Exactly one write brings it about: record_vehicle_valuation_559b4236 is the only tool that creates a listings_valuation_reassessed row. Why false: initial_state.listings_inspections.b27e9b26-89fd-467b-bc31-657154cb3aba.record_date = 2025-04-02, 349 days before the handling date, and it is the only valuation on the record. Deletion sensitivity, run: governing value 40,331.11 instead of 34,976.99.
   Edge 3 (price waits on the class move). kind value_input, gate band_ceiling, form state. Sentence: "The daily price a host may ask is fixed only once the vehicle value standing on the listing is the value the marketplace has settled on for it." Four-point test: (1) "only once" is the connective and the result is the price this policy fixes; (2) the XX side is the record-visible state of the value carried on the listing; (3) no code names; (4) a hard requirement, scoped to exactly the value standing on the listing. Exactly one write brings it about: reassign_value_class_4bb6b10c is the only tool that writes market_value_amount on a listing. Why false: initial_state.listings_vehicles.17ff06a1-563b-49a5-b427-5a81c8a26ec9.market_value_amount = 41800.0 with .value_class_name = Keyturn Premium Class Listing, which is the superseded valuation of April 2025 rather than the value the marketplace settles on today. Deletion sensitivity, run: 162.00 instead of 148.50.
   Direction of the three sentences was chosen by how the desk itself would state each result, not by alternation: a charge or a figure "is fixed only after" what it rests on is complete, while a class move, which the host feels as something done to them, reads naturally as "is not settled before". Two of the three run affirmative and one negated, and task 1 carries both directions too, so the charter is not in one direction throughout.
   The customer's own write is the root: set_daily_price_59fd8a00 is owner=user, because the price a host asks for their own vehicle is theirs to set — the blueprint says so in as many words — and the desk unlocks it and hands it over at the root's place in the order. It completes on the spot; nothing clears afterwards.
   Tools validate nothing: see prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block, which cites each function body.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Write 1, subject listings_defect_reported, governed by listings_evt_defect alone. Its one gate scoped to that subject, defect_recorded_while_active_listing, requires the record to be opened against a listing in pending_review, listed, snoozed or suspended; the listing stands at status listed (system_record authority, pre-action, correlated by listings_vehicles.vehicle_id, which is the tool's vehicle_id argument), so it holds. Write 2, subject listings_valuation_reassessed, governed by listings_evt_valuation alone, whose gate valuation_refresh_due is a time gate: the starting business event is the class's refresh interval, the authoritative anchor is listings_inspections.record_date, the clock is frozen_time, the duration comes from params.valuation_refresh_days (270 for the Keyturn Premium Class Listing), the counting rule is whole calendar days from the date of the last valuation, the direction is not_before and the boundary is inclusive. Positive case: the anchor of 2025-04-02 plus 270 days is 2025-12-28, and the handling date of 2026-03-17 is 349 days past the anchor, so the valuation is due. Negative case: on 2025-12-27, 269 days past the anchor, the interval is not reached and the correct handling would be to wait. Write 3, subject listings_class_reassigned, governed by listings_evt_valuation; none of that policy's eligibility applies to the class reassignment subject, so it is carried as policy_scope and the whole of the rest of the policy — that the valuation governs the class, that the move takes effect on the date the valuation is recorded, that a class change moves the price band with it — is inherited. Write 4, subject listings_price_updated, governed by listings_price, which states no eligibility, so policy_scope again and its floor, ceiling, movement limit and confirmed-booking clauses are inherited whole. No base time gate had its anchor changed anywhere, and every base eligibility is either inherited item by item into solvability_contract.gold_actions[].base_preconditions or, in the single case of listings_evt_valuation's declared-value clause, named in listings_ext_class_assignment.overwrite.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is one listing, vehicle 17ff06a1-563b-49a5-b427-5a81c8a26ec9, the host's only one. Every aggregate is scoped to it by vehicle_id, which the condition-record finder filters on; there is no second vehicle whose records could be drawn in. The fault record written carries source_inspection_id = ffa7dba4-2774-4205-9aae-2d4221d154a4, so it is correlated to the exact advisory it settles rather than to the vehicle at large. Rows deliberately excluded by the windows rather than by choice: the windscreen chip of 2025-01-20, fourteen months old, falls outside every rolling twelve month count and is the near-miss for the repeat-fault ladder; the completed inspection of 2024-09-12 and the readings of 2025-01-18 and 2025-09-10 fall outside the twelve-month fault window entirely. The cross-category objects are correlated by vehicle_id as well: enrolment 4755f3be-1ee3-421d-a789-0b3d8545ab49 is held on this vehicle, care plan 905f2610-782d-4e19-a338-8a92f310f785 services this vehicle, subscription 223f9fb5-4a53-4e46-b591-3ad58ce6b9f0 covers this vehicle. Nothing existing reverses or compensates anything here; the recall clearance 8084f168-19af-4827-8631-b6d7933a415b settles exactly one source object, the open recall 1acb47af-ef39-42b8-a522-ca8882a9d253, and names it in source_inspection_id.

7. FACTOR CARD. Twenty-one declared factors over four computations, each proved load-bearing by the Step 5 sensitivity run (figures in computations[].factor_sensitivity, all recomputed by check_compute):
   listings_ext_fault_intake (6): repeat_fault_standard, parameter, tier "fewer than three reports with at least one running-gear fault", six photographs in place of four, baseline 9 against 10; inspection_clock_addition, parameter, tier "past one hundred and eighty days with fewer than two thousand miles left", plus three, baseline 8; recall_standing_addition, parameter, tier "open recall with a clearance verified", plus one, baseline 9; odometer_band_addition, parameter, tier "thirty thousand or more but below sixty thousand", plus two, baseline 9; valuation_band_addition, parameter, tier "thirty thousand dollars or more but below sixty thousand", plus one, baseline 9; care_plan_documentation_basis, method, cross-difficulty on service, tier "exactly one completed care plan visit in the rolling twelve months" (rows aae0ed7a-c934-430e-8608-fc65cccfa7f5 under plan 905f2610-782d-4e19-a338-8a92f310f785), three quarters rounded up, baseline 13. Whole-baseline fall-back 4 against gold 10.
   listings_ext_valuation_assessment (6): use_intensity_rate, parameter, multi-source; step_down_anchor_basis, method; fault_pattern_holdback, parameter, multi-source, and the binding the first prerequisite edge carries; damage_history_holdback, parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty on hostplan (rows f3cbe600-b68f-4eb1-8727-50c3c3c651cb and cec82a1b-7a86-4605-a238-f38be308c3d6 under enrolment 4755f3be-1ee3-421d-a789-0b3d8545ab49); advisory_condition_holdback, parameter, multi-source; maintained_vehicle_step_basis, method, cross-difficulty on service (rows b5e13623-ed7a-46fd-b638-40a21e2c3cca and aae0ed7a-c934-430e-8608-fc65cccfa7f5). Whole-baseline fall-back 39,041.20 against gold 35,294.25.
   listings_ext_class_assignment (5): marketplace_figure_basis, method, the binding the second edge carries; odometer_band_share, parameter; documented_service_share, parameter, cross-difficulty on service; recovery_history_share, parameter, cross-difficulty on roadside (row 7a945b33-accd-4c73-af7f-c385bc154e21 under subscription 223f9fb5-4a53-4e46-b591-3ad58ce6b9f0); declared_value_settlement, method, cross-difficulty on hostplan. Whole-baseline fall-back 41,800.00 against gold 34,976.99.
   listings_ext_price_reset (4): value_band_boundaries, parameter, multi-source, the binding the third edge carries; daily_movement_rate, parameter, multi-source; out_of_band_correction_basis, method; cover_standing_band_share, parameter, cross-difficulty on hostplan. Whole-baseline fall-back 95.00 against gold 148.50.
   Multi-source floor: satisfied several times over (use_intensity_rate, fault_pattern_holdback, damage_history_holdback, advisory_condition_holdback, repeat_fault_standard, inspection_clock_addition, recall_standing_addition, value_band_boundaries, daily_movement_rate). Cross-difficulty floor: satisfied by six factors reading hostplan, service and roadside, every one of them with its evidence seeded for this customer. Cross-category value floor: CFIELD on service and hostplan and XSUM/XCOUNT on hostplan_claims and service_visits, not a bare EXISTS anywhere. Near-miss records planted on purpose: the windscreen chip of 2025-01-20 sits just outside the twelve-month fault window; the care visit of 2024-06-03 sits inside the twenty-four month window but outside the twelve-month one, so a reader who uses one window for both ladders gets the documentation basis wrong; the appraisal of 3,180.00 sits just under the five thousand dollar line that would move the damage holdback from four hundredths to eight; and the claim-free date of 2024-11-20, fifteen months back, sits well short of the twenty-four months that would hand the whole declared value to the host. No stamp on any row names any tier outcome; value_class_assessed on the valuation of 2025-04-02 records what that valuation concluded and is not read by any rule. Nothing was ever kept for the count: every factor moves the number.

8. THE WORLD (Step 3). One customer, one listing, twelve condition records over eighteen months, and four cross-category holdings with their ledgers. Why each class of row exists and what its removal changes: the two completed inspections set last_inspection_date, the advisory that starts the whole tree and the mileage interval — remove the inspection of 2025-09-15 and the tree has no root fault, the step-down anchor falls back eleven months and the advisory holdback vanishes; the five odometer readings carry the mileage credit to exactly 1,080 (the sum of all twelve miles_delta values, matching the listing field identically) and set the highest standing reading of 35,820 — remove the last one and the odometer band, the mileage share and the use-intensity rate all move; the three fault reports set the twelve-month fault counts that four separate ladders read; the valuation of 2025-04-02 is the anchor of the refresh clock, the starting value of the step-down and the "highest valuation standing" fall-back of the class move; the recall clearance of 2025-10-25 is what puts the recall addition on its middle tier rather than its top one and is why the listing is not suspended. Cross-category: the protection enrolment carries the declared value and the claim-free date the class move reads and is the parent of the two claim rows the valuation and the price read; the care plan carries the credit the service share reads and is the parent of the two visits three separate ladders read; the roadside subscription is the parent of the callout the recovery share reads. Automatic clauses checked row by row before seeding: the inspection clock (the credit is positive, so nothing is overdue and no suspension is owed); the registration grace (expiry 2026-11-30 is eight months out, so no document suspension is owed); the safety-defect grace (the only safety-bearing faults are the tyre tread report, already twelve weeks old and not suspended, and the open recall, which was cleared by a verified clearance seventeen days after it was raised, so the base rule's "returns only when a recall clearance document has been verified" is satisfied and suspension_reason is none); the defect-count compliance review (three reports in the rolling twelve months once the brake wear fault is written, against a threshold of four, so no compliance review is ignited). No cache field is deliberately stale in this task: miles_to_next_inspection agrees with the ledger exactly, and the discrepancy the task turns on is between the listing's value and the market, which the policy adjudicates rather than a cache.

9. PERSONA (Step 4). Delia Ruvalcaba is written as a fast-talking architect on a lunch break with one errand: get the car earning more over a long weekend. Volunteered at the opening: the car, the city, that it is the only one she lists, the price she is asking, and the request itself — every one of them entailed by initial_state (daily_price_amount 180.00, home_city Phoenix, one listings_vehicles row, model_year 2021, odometer 35,820, listed_date 2023-04-20). Given only when asked: her name, her mobile, her licence number, her zip, her email, that she does not know her member reference, and that she has no idea what the car is valued at. Reacted to only after the agent speaks: disappointment at a figure lower than she asks today, one short "is that really the most?", and running the price change herself once it is handed over. She is not an oracle: she never names a target figure, never mentions a fault, a valuation or a class, never asks the desk to check anything in particular, and reacts identically whether the agent's figure is right or wrong. The arc closes exactly where evaluation_criteria closes — her last reaction answers the price change and she rings off, asking for nothing beyond it, with no document to send and no statement to put anything on.

10. VERIFICATION ACTUALLY RUN (Step 5). The four computations were evaluated in topological order over initial_state plus the preceding gold writes, with the real tools replayed between steps, using the same evaluator the gate uses. Output:
    listings_ext_fault_intake -> 10   whole-baseline 4    factor baselines 9 / 8 / 9 / 9 / 9 / 13
    listings_ext_valuation_assessment -> 35294.25   whole-baseline 39041.2   factor baselines 35592.2 / 34052.79 / 37700.67 / 36898.53 / 36096.39 / 35128.72
    listings_ext_class_assignment -> 34976.99   whole-baseline 41800.0   factor baselines 40331.11 / 35503.6 / 34725.35 / 35324.47 / 34053.97
    listings_ext_price_reset -> 148.5   whole-baseline 95.0   factor baselines 95.0 / 153.0 / 162.0 / 165.0
    Prerequisite sensitivity, each edge's depended-on write skipped and everything else replayed unchanged: skip the fault record -> valuation 36497.46; skip the valuation -> governing value 40331.11; skip the class move -> price 162.0. Every edge moves a scored figure. Every figure above is reproduced by check_compute, which recomputes expected, every factor_sensitivity entry and every baseline_result at handling time.

11. TWO-WAY EQUIVALENCE OF RULE AND COMPUTE. Forward, every binding that reads the world or makes a choice quotes the rule sentence it implements in compute_basis: the four ladders of each policy quote their ladder sentence verbatim, the aggregates quote the sentence that states their window and filter, the combination bindings quote the sentence that states how the parts combine, and the result binding quotes the sentence that states the rounding and the floor. Reverse sweep, sentence by sentence: every sentence of every rule is claimed. In listings_ext_fault_intake, r1/r2/r3 are claimed by result and by the standard figure, r4 by report_subtotal, r5 to r9 by the five addition ladders and r10 by documented_requirement. In listings_ext_valuation_assessment, v1 and v2 by base_value and anchor_months, v3 by stepped_value, v4 and v5 by result, v6 is the prerequisite sentence, v7 to v12 by the six factor bindings. In listings_ext_class_assignment, w1 and w3 by result, w2 and w6 by marketplace_figure, w4 by adjusted_figure, w5 is the prerequisite sentence, w7 to w10 by the four remaining factor bindings. In listings_ext_price_reset, p1 to p6 by the baseline chain (band, price_now, capped_price, lowest_today, held_price, result), p7 is the prerequisite sentence, p8 to p11 by the four factor bindings. Sensitive words cross-checked: every "rolling twelve months" and "rolling twenty-four months" has within_months= on its aggregate; every "highest standing" has MAX; every "most recently recorded" has LATEST; "rounded half away from zero to two decimal places" has RND(...,2); "rounded up to a whole photograph" has the explicit ceiling form; "held to the ceiling ... lifted to the floor" has MN then MX; and no filter appears in an expression that the quoted sentence does not state.

12. THE ORDER OF OPERATIONS PINNED IN PROSE. Where the arithmetic admitted two readings, the rule says which: the fault-report additions are "summed and the total is added once ... rather than each addition being applied to the figure the one before it produced"; the valuation step-down is "worked out as one rate for the whole stretch of months and taken off the starting value once, and is never compounded month by month", and its holdbacks are "summed into a single rate, that rate is applied once to the stepped figure"; the class-move adjustments are the opposite and say so, "each adjustment is a share applied to the figure the one before it produced, taken in the order mileage, service record and recovery history"; and the price rule states the whole sequence, the cover share first, the movement floor second as a greater-of, and the band held last. Every rounding names its mode, its precision and its moment.

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT ALONE. With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier set aside, and working only from the prose that will be published, the tool schemas, what the finders return and what the caller actually says: the caller asks for the highest price allowed; the price rule says the band is read off the value standing on the listing, and its own sentence says the price is not fixed until that value is the value the marketplace has settled on; the listing shows a value from a valuation dated eleven months ago, so the marketplace has not settled on it today; the class rule says the class is not settled before a valuation inside thirty days stands, and the condition record shows none; the valuation rule says it is not fixed until every advised fault stands as a report, and the condition record shows an advisory naming brake wear with no report against it. That chain is forced in one direction only and gives the same four writes in the same order. Working each figure from the published ladders gives 10, 35,294.25, 34,976.99 and 148.50 — equal to gold. No second reading was found: the windows are stated with their endpoints, the bands with their boundaries, the roundings with their moment, and each ladder's tiers are pairwise disjoint as written, so no customer sits on two.

14. WHAT A CARELESS AGENT GETS WRONG, AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES IT. Quoting the premium ceiling from the class on the listing gives 320.00 and skips three writes. Counting the windscreen chip of January 2025 inside the twelve-month fault window puts the repeat-fault ladder on its top tier and the evidence figure at 14 rather than 10. Using the twelve-month care-visit count for the twenty-four month service share, or the reverse, moves both the evidence figure and the governing value. Anchoring the step-down on the valuation rather than on the later completed inspection gives 34,052.79. Taking the declared value whole, as a reader who misses the claim-free condition would, gives 35,900.00. Applying the movement limit before the band rather than as a floor after the cover share gives 144.00. Each of these is excluded by a sentence of the published rule read carefully — the window endpoints, the anchor rule, the claim-free condition and the stated order of the two comparisons — rather than by anything the customer says.

15. CLOSURE. policy -> target_tool -> computation.step/arg -> gold call -> terminal state: listings_ext_fault_intake -> log_vehicle_fault_a3e017f7 -> step 11 attached_photo_count -> a listings_defect_reported row dated 2026-03-17 carrying ten photographs; listings_ext_valuation_assessment -> record_vehicle_valuation_559b4236 -> step 13 assessed_value_amount -> a listings_valuation_reassessed row at 35,294.25 naming the standard band; listings_ext_class_assignment -> reassign_value_class_4bb6b10c -> step 15 governing_value_amount -> the listing carrying 34,976.99 in the Keyturn Standard Class Listing; listings_ext_price_reset -> set_daily_price_59fd8a00 -> step 17 daily_price_amount -> the listing asking 148.50 a day. charter_scope.extended_policies equals the set of computations.policy_id equals the four problems of the tree, required_documents repeats it verbatim in order, and charter_scope.task_tools is the four tools in first-call order. No tool, policy or obligation hangs outside the tree, and the whole consultation runs at one frozen_time with no wait, no clearing and no future date anywhere in it.

REVISION ROUND 2 (source-layer policy audit, report ids T0-F1, T0-F2, T0-F3, CG-1d, CG-3, CG-4, T0-OBS-1 to T0-OBS-4). Base is frozen; every change below is inside this difficulty's own write domain and none of the four scored values, the tree, the seed or the persona moved. `check_compute` re-run after the change reproduces 10 / 35,294.25 / 34,976.99 / 148.50 and every published baseline and sensitivity figure unchanged.

T0-F1 and CG-1a (base `listings_evt_valuation` sentence 6 gives 165.00 where the policy gives 148.50). Symptom: two clauses in force fixed the price after a class move. Root cause: `listings_ext_price_reset` inherited that sentence with `overwrite: []`, so the deviation was never declared. Change: `listings_evt_valuation` is added to `listings_ext_price_reset.base_policy_refs` as input lineage, and an `overwrite` entry now quotes the base sentence verbatim — "A class change moves the price floor and ceiling with it, and a daily price outside the new class's band is brought to the nearer boundary rather than left outside it." — and names the sentence of this policy's own rule that replaces it: "Where a fresh valuation moves the band a listing is read against, the price is not brought to the nearer boundary of the new band and left there: it is carried forward, taken through the share of the band the vehicle's cover standing leaves open, held to the movement the day allows, and only then brought inside the band." The two readings no longer stand side by side: the extended clause is declared to supersede the base one, so 148.50 is the only figure the charter entails. Re-run: EXTENDED OK, SOLVABILITY OK (the added ref is lineage only — `listings_evt_valuation`'s subjects are the valuation and the class move, so it governs no price write and `base_preconditions` is unchanged at `listings_price` / policy_scope).

T0-F3 and CG-1c (base `listings_price` sentence 1 forbids the clamping the policy performs). Change: a second `overwrite` entry quotes that sentence verbatim — "The host sets what they ask for their own vehicle, within the floor and ceiling of the class the vehicle sits in, and a price outside that band is refused rather than quietly clamped." — replaced by a new sentence of this policy's rule: "The band a listing is read against is settled from the vehicle value standing on the listing rather than from the class the vehicle sits in, and a price standing outside that band is brought inside it rather than refused." The refuse-rather-than-clamp reading is now retired by declaration rather than by silence, so the third terminal state the audit found (refuse, no price write) is no longer entailed.

CG-1d (the band and the movement limit read off the class in base, off the standing value and the listing's record in extended; the lockout not carried). The same `overwrite` entry above covers the band half of base sentence 1. A third entry quotes base sentence 2 verbatim — "The daily price may not move by more than the class's daily movement limit in one day, and after a change the price is locked for the class's lockout period in whole elapsed hours, so that a vehicle's price cannot be moved around a booking in progress." — replaced by "The most a price may move in a day is settled from how long the listing has been live and what its fault record shows rather than from the class, and no lockout period runs against the listing after a price is changed." That states the two divergences the audit named, the source of the movement limit and the dropped lockout, in the policy's own prose.

Delia Ruvalcaba shares one car on Keyturn, a 2021 Audi Q5 she keeps at her place in Phoenix, and she has had it on the marketplace since the spring of 2023. She is an architect, she talks quickly, and she is ringing on her lunch break with one thing on her mind: the long weekend at the end of the month, when every car in town gets booked, and she wants the Q5 earning as much as it is allowed to. She has no idea what the marketplace currently values the car at; if the agent asks, she says it has never been appraised in front of her and she would not want to guess. She takes whatever explanation she is given. When the agent hands the price change over to her she runs it with the figure she has been told, and she confirms what she sees on the listing afterwards. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain, every problem having exactly one prerequisite, so the topological order fault intake, valuation, class move, price is the only order the edges admit and there are no parallel prerequisites to reorder. Each edge is also strictly needed in that order by value: the fault report changes the fault count the valuation's condition holdback reads, the valuation changes the marketplace figure the class move reads, and the class move changes the vehicle value the price band is read off. Reversing any adjacent pair evaluates the later policy on a world its own prerequisite sentence says it may not be evaluated on, and the figures 36,497.46, 40,331.11 and 162.00 recorded under edge_load_bearing are what that produces.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the fault record leaves two fault reports in the rolling twelve months instead of three, so the condition holdback is three hundredths instead of six and the valuation comes out at 36,497.46 instead of 35,294.25. That figure then falls in the same band, but it carries through the class move (36,578.74 in place of 34,976.99 on a re-run) and the scored valuation argument is already wrong.

Skipping the valuation leaves no valuation within thirty days, so the marketplace figure falls back to the highest valuation standing, 41,800.00, and the governing value comes out at 40,331.11 instead of 34,976.99 — which would move the listing into the premium class rather than the standard one.

Skipping the class move leaves 41,800.00 standing on the listing, so the band read is the premium band, the price asked of 180.00 no longer stands above its ceiling of 320.00, the out-of-band correction does not fire and the price comes out at 162.00 instead of 148.50.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario contains no mention of a fault, an advisory, a valuation, a value class or a class move, and names none of the three prerequisite problems or the things they settle. She never asks the desk to look for anything in particular, never suggests that something may have to be sorted out first, and reacts to the lower figure with disappointment rather than with an explanation of it.
